hook.text: Rainforest Alliance, Organic, UTZ, Fair Trade, Bird Friendly—coffee has more certifications than almost any product.

buildup.text: Each label certifies different things: environmental standards, wages, shade-growing, or chemical-free farming.

discovery.text: Certification costs money ($5,000–$20,000+ annually). Small farmers often can't afford to prove they're already ethical.

twist.text: Some excellent, ethical farms operate without any certification. Some certified farms barely meet minimum standards.

climax.text: Consumer confusion grows with every new label. Knowing which logo means what requires serious homework.

punchline.text: More labels, more confusion. Certification isn't clarity yet.

quiz.question: Why do many small ethical farmers lack certifications?
